# Rodiwala (also written Rodi Wala or Roadi Wala)

> Construction material chahiye? Rodiwala contractors, builders, site engineers aur homeowners ko material source karne aur delivery coordinate karne mein help karta hai.

Rodiwala quote-led construction material sourcing service hai. Fixed prices, universal stock ya blanket delivery coverage ka claim nahi karta. Availability, delivered rate aur feasibility material, quantity, site, route aur required date ke hisaab se confirm hoti hai.

## Core materials

- [Construction materials catalogue and buying guide](https://rodiwala.lovable.app/buy-construction-material): 10 mm aggregate (rodi), 20 mm aggregate (rodi), stone dust, M-sand / crushed sand, ready-mix concrete (RMC) aur cement, plus complete requirement bhejne aur quote lene ka process.
- [10 mm aggregate](https://rodiwala.lovable.app/aggregate/10-mm-rodi)
- [20 mm aggregate](https://rodiwala.lovable.app/aggregate/20-mm-rodi)
- [Stone dust](https://rodiwala.lovable.app/stone-dust)
- [M-sand / crushed sand](https://rodiwala.lovable.app/m-sand)
- [Ready-mix concrete](https://rodiwala.lovable.app/ready-mix-concrete)
- [Cement](https://rodiwala.lovable.app/cement)

## Delivery and contact

- [Delivery areas and feasibility](https://rodiwala.lovable.app/delivery-areas): Location bhejo, route aur freight feasibility check hogi.
- [How the quote process works](https://rodiwala.lovable.app/how-it-works): Requirement, availability, delivered rate aur dispatch ka process.
- [Contact Rodiwala](https://rodiwala.lovable.app/contact): +91 94161 65465 par call karo ya WhatsApp par requirement bhejo.

## Useful requirement details

Requirement mein material aur size ya grade, quantity aur unit, delivery locality ya pin code, required date aur vehicle access ya unloading notes include karo.
